title: Arm Wrestle!
description: Verse a non player in an Arm Wrestle. Anyone can win.\n\nFilm it if they consent.(The Summer Clause: You gain a bonus band if you arm wrestle a cop)

title: Honk Hunt
description: Get any vehicle to honk their horn.

title: Hickery Dickery Dock
description:
Find the closest analogue clock and sing the nursery rhyme "Hickery Dickery Dock".

You must record video evidence to claim your band.

The lyrics are as follows:

Hickory dickory dock
The sheep hid from its flock
The flock called once
The sheep did run
Hickory dickory dock
Hickory dickory dock
The sheep hid from its flock
The flock called twice
And that was nice!
Hickory dickory dock
Hickory dickory dock
The sheep hid from its flock
The flock called thrice
And that was wise
Hickory dickory dock

title: Business Card Rush
description:
Collect business cards from different locations or people. You have 5 minutes from now to find the first card.

The timer resets to 5 minutes every time you find another card.

The challenge is over when your timer ends. The challenge is vetoed if you find no cards.

You receive 1 band per card.

Your time starts now!

title: Instant Veto!
description:
UH OH!

This challenge is an instant veto. You must wait 8 minutes before scanning or participating in a challenge.

Sometimes that's the risk you take…

title: Do You Know The Muffin Man?
description:
You must call out "Do yOu kNoW tHe MuFfIn MaN?".

You must get a non-player to respond with one of the following:
- "Who lives on Drury Lane?"
- "The muffin man?"

Please film only yourself while you attempt this challenge.

title: Loop de Loop
description: Take any form of public transport at least for one stop. Return to the node location you're currently at.\n\nYou may only receive your band when you return to this location.

title: Photo Recreation?
description: Find at least 2 teammates (3 people total) and recreate this photo.\n\nEach participating player receives a band.

title: Leap Frog Relay!
description:
Find at least 2 teammates to play leap frog.

Everyone must leap over each other at least twice. Provide video evidence.

All participating players receive a band.

title: Crab Walk!
description: Crab walk to the nearest bench including crab hands. Provide video footage.\n\nYou don't need to do crab hands with the hand you use to film yourself.

title: Time For A Fit Check
description: Find the nearest clothing store that is having a sale. You have 6 minutes from when you enter the store to put an outfit together and model it.\n\nYou do not need to purchase it. Make a short video advertising your get up.

title: Human Pyramid!
description:
Find at least 2 teammates and make a human pyramid.

Each participant gets a band.

You must film your attempt.

title: Dizzy Dash
description: Spin around as fast as you can for 20 seconds and then run to the nearest street pole that's at least 10m away and back.\n\nYou must film your attempt from your POV.

title: Wake Up Jeff!
description:
You may NOT read this challenge aloud. You may NOT tell anyone you have pulled this challenge!

Pretend to be sleeping. This can be done in any position that is safe and comfortable. A teammate must physically touch you to wake you up without being prompted by you.

Each player involved gets a band.

title: Lonely Statue
description:
Pick a location and stand like a statue with your hand out waiting for a high-five.

You may not use your phone for anything other than a timer during this challenge.

You must stand in that position for 8 minutes. You may take a band and stop standing in that position only if a non-player high-fives you.

You do NOT have to wait another 8 minutes as a veto period if you don't get a high-five. You have already served the veto period. And you got rejected by everyone around you... Ouch...

Your time starts now!

title: Spelling Bee Shootout
description:
Find 2 teammates for a Spelling Bee Shootout.

Each teammate may attempt each word once. You may Google a word if you don't know it. You may use it in a sentence if the contestants request it.

Between the two of them they must correctly spell 3 of these 5 words exactly as they are spelled here:
Accommodate
Their
Mourning
Mussel
Leisure.

All participating players get a band if they succeed. The challenge is vetoed if they fail.

title: Cairn You Stack 'Em?
description:
You must create a single stack of rocks using rocks found nearby.

You must stack at least 3 rocks in order to not veto this challenge.

You receive bands depending on how many rocks you can stack:
3 Rocks = 1 Band
6 Rocks = 2 Bands
9+ Rocks = 3 Bands

You have 5 minutes. Your time starts right now!

title: Tattoo Interview
description:
Interview someone with tattoos. Ask them at least 3 of the following questions:
What's the meaning of one of your tattoos?
Where are you from?
What was your first tattoo?
Why did you get it?
If you could remove a tattoo which one would it be and why?

You may film if you choose to and only if the interviewee consents.

title: Feel The Burn!
description:
Hold either:
- A Plank (straight back while resting only on your forearms and toes)
or
- A Squat (fully seated position with your hands out in front of you).

Choose your poison and hold it for 90 seconds to complete the challenge.

You may attempt only once and you must film this attempt.

title: Pet Interview
description:
Interview a person with a pet. Ask them the following questions:
What is the owner's name?
What is the pet's name?
What breed is the pet?
How long have they had the pet for?
What's the most expensive/annoying thing the pet has ever done?

You may film if you choose to and only if the interviewee consents.

title: Run Monkey Run!
description: Go to the nearest park or grassy area. Do a 'monkey run' (running on all fours) for 30 seconds.\n\nYou must provide video evidence.

title: I Want It That Way
description:
Sing aloud the first verse and chorus of "I Want It That Way" by The Backstreet Boys.
Multiple players from your team may attempt this challenge together. Each participating player gets a band.

You must film your attempt.

For the uninitiated... here are the lyrics:

You are my fire
The one desire
Believe when I say
I want it that way
Tell me why
Ain't nothin' but a heartache
Tell me why
Ain't nothing but a mistake
Tell me why
I never wanna hear you say
I want it that way

title: Seriously? I Know…
description:
Call any non-player and hold a phone call for 60 seconds using only the words 'Seriously' and 'I know'.

If they don't pick up on the first attempt or if they hang up within 60 seconds it's an instant veto.

You get one attempt.

title: Kanga-Race
description:
Verse a non-player in a kangaroo race.

You must both jump like a kangaroo past two stores or buildings. You start at the beginning of the first store/building and finish at the end of the second.

You must film your attempt only if your opponent consents.

title: Look! It's A Rainbow!
description:
Create a rainbow with the following colours:

Red
Yellow
Pink
Green
Orange
Purple
Blue

You may only use natural organic items around you to construct your rainbow.

You must take a photo of your masterpiece.

title: Cartwheel Craziness
description:
Both you and a willing non-player must attempt a cartwheel.

You do not have to do a good cartwheel but it must be a genuine attempt.

Film your attempt only if the other person consents.

title: Months Alphabet Race
description:
Race a non-player to say the months of the year in alphabetical order. You do not have to win.

No practice beforehand - not even sneaky mental practice!

Film your attempt only if they consent.

title: Bird Hunt!
description: You must take a photo of 5 different species of bird.\n\nYou have 10 minutes. Your time starts now!

title: Fast Facts Quiz
description:
Ask a non-player to play fast facts with you. Film their attempt only if they consent.

You must ask them the 10 questions listed below:

What colours are in the Australian flag? (Ans: Blue + Red + White)
How many stars are in the Southern Cross? (Ans: 5)
What 2 Aussie animals can be found on the Australian coat of arms? (Ans: Kangaroo & Emu)
What does CD stand for in terms of data storage? (Ans: Compact Disc)
What is the tallest building in Sydney CBD? (Ans: Either the Crown Tower or Centrepoint Tower)
Name the 2 main bridges that allow traffic in and out of Sydney CBD. (Ans: ANZAC Bridge + Sydney Harbour Bridge)
Which body part has more bones - hands or feet? (Ans: Hands)
What is a human's largest organ? (Ans: Skin)
Which one is not like the other?
- Wallabie
- Koala
- Joey
- Alligator
- Jabiru
(Ans: Alligator – it doesn’t live in Australia.)
In what state of Australia will you find the world's happiest animal - the Quokka? (Ans: WA)

You may take one band once you've completed this game with the non-player.

description:
UH OH!

This challenge is an instant veto. You must wait 8 minutes before scanning or participating in a challenge.

Sometimes that's the risk you take…

description:
UH OH!

This challenge is an instant veto. You must wait 8 minutes before scanning or participating in a challenge.

Sometimes that's the risk you take…

title: Victory Lap
description: Run a celebratory lap around a public object while cheering dramatically. Film the lap.

title: Treat yourself
description: Go and purchase a 50c soft serve cone from McDonalds. If you put the soft serve on your head like a unicorn and take a selfie. You get a bonus band.

title: The Fashion Runway
description: Turn a public walkway into a fashion runway for 30 seconds.

title: Public Safety Announcement
description: Find a traffic cone/ warning sign/ or safety barrier. For 20 seconds you must act as its official spokesperson and dramatically warn the public about the "dangers" nearby.

title: Public Fitness Instructor
description: Lead a real or imagined group through a 30-second workout. Film the workout.

title: Pitch Perfect
description: You and 3 teammates must create a 20-second song using only body percussion and voices. Each player gets a band.

title: Paper Air Ace
description: Fold and fly a paper airplane. It must travel at least 5 metres.

title: Ice Bucket Challenge Budget Edition
description: Carefully pour a metric cup of water over a willing teammate's head. Film the reaction.

title: Rival Recon
description: Take a photo of a player from another team. Their wristband must be visible in the photo.
